description: Search the AI agents on BNB Smart Chain that can do a given task, in plain words. Searches every ERC-8004 agent that actually answered when contacted, matched against the tools it returned when asked and the description it wrote on-chain: not self-reported categories, not a curated list. Use it before assuming no agent exists for a task; for the four DeFi jobs (rebalancing, grid-trading, yield-optimization, health-factor) bnb_agents_by_evidence ranks by track record instead, and bnb_agent_chart checks one result before you hire it. Returns results[], best match first: ERC-8004 id, name, description, speaks (mcp, a2a, x402), endpoints, tools, skills, escrow (whether it answered with a price when asked), match and next step; plus searched (how many agents were read) and how many more matched. No match returns returned: 0, not an error. Read-only, free, no key; from the last daily census.

hireable.description: Optional: only agents that answered with a price the last time they were asked

query.description: What you need done, in plain words — e.g. "swap routing", "stablecoin payments", "pool depth"

speaks.description: Optional: require a protocol. One or more of mcp, a2a, x402 (comma-separated).

name: find_agents_on_bnb_chain
